d.d: To jimmy (something); to mess up or mess with (something).
Sprinkles used as a topping for ice cream, cookies, or cupcakes.
A device used to circumvent a locking mechanism.
A jemmy; a crowbar used by burglars to open windows and doors.
To pry (something, especially a lock) open with or as if with a crowbar.

d.x: There were three Jims at my old workplace.
